entities.name: Heteroaryl Suzuki coupling
observations: A heteroaryl trifluoromethylsulfonate reacts with a heteroaryl pinacol boronate under a Pd biaryl-phosphine catalyst and sodium bicarbonate; the missing component is the solvent.
Closest ORD evidence includes a related quinolinyl triflate coupling in THF, but with a different partner and catalyst; no yield was reported.
Related DMF/water records used different partners and bases; no direct yield comparison was found. Methanol was not found in related records.

entities.name: Tetrahydrofuran solvent
observations: THF is the best-supported candidate among the choices by the closest analog record for a related heteroaryl triflate coupling and is chemically compatible with Suzuki–Miyaura boronate chemistry.

observations: DMF/water appears in related records with different coupling partners and bases; no direct yield advantage was established for the specified reaction.
